title: Thar Process
content: Thar Process is a U.S. engineering company focused on supercritical fluid processing equipment and related production systems. Its technology is relevant to aerogel process development where supercritical CO2 handling and drying workflows are important for laboratory, pilot, and industrial applications. Thar Process supports customers working on extraction, materials processing, and scale-up programs that require controlled supercritical systems.
